Rabsca

Bug Psychic

Paldea · Generation 9

Rabsca is a Bug/Psychic-type Rolling Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3.5 kg. It evolves from Rellor. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (115), with a base stat total of 470.
